# GLM goodness-of-fit {#sec-glmgoodnessoffit}

#deviance calcs for probit regression
Mb <- iris.probit
Ma <- update(iris.probit,.~.-Petal.Length)
summary(Mb)
summary(Ma)
summary(Ma)$deviance-summary(Mb)$deviance
1-pchisq(summary(Ma)$deviance-summary(Mb)$deviance,1)

summary(Mb)$null.deviance-summary(Mb)$deviance
1-pchisq(summary(Mb)$null.deviance-summary(Mb)$deviance,2)

summary(Mb)$deviance
1-pchisq(33,147)

#confusion matrix
table(iris$Species=='virginica',round(Ma$fitted.values))

#roc curve
roc.x <- sapply(seq(0.000,1,0.001),function(z) mean(Ma$fitted.values[iris$Species!='virginica']>=z))
roc.y <- sapply(seq(0.000,1,0.001),function(z) mean(Ma$fitted.values[iris$Species=='virginica']>=z))
mean(roc.y)
plot(roc.x,roc.y,type='l',xlim=c(0,1),ylim=c(0,1),
     xlab='False positive rate',ylab='True positive rate',
     main='ROC curve for simple virginica classifier',
     col='#800000',lwd=2)
lines(x=c(0,1),y=c(0,1),lty=2,lwd=2,col='grey50')
text(0.6,0.4,'AUC=0.9902',col='#800000',cex=1)

#comparing aic of logistic vs probit regression
admit.probit <- glm(admit~SAT,family=binomial(link='probit'))
c(AIC.logistic=AIC(admit.glm),AIC.probit=AIC(admit.probit),
  AIC.ols=AIC(glm(admit~SAT,family=gaussian)))
plot(x=seq(400,1600,5),y=predict(admit.glm,newdata=list(SAT=seq(400,1600,5)),type='response'),
     type='l',xlab='SAT score',ylab='Probability of admission',
     main='Competing models for college admission',col='#800000',lwd=2)
lines(x=seq(400,1600,5),y=predict(admit.probit,newdata=list(SAT=seq(400,1600,5)),type='response'),
       lwd=2,lty=3,)
abline(reg=lm(admit~SAT),col='grey50',lwd=2)
points(SAT,admit)
legend(x='topleft',lwd=2,lty=c(1,3,1),col=c('#800000','black','grey50'),
       legend=c(expression(paste('Probit ',(AIC %~~% 16.1))),
                expression(paste('Logistic ',(AIC %~~% 16.3))),
                expression(paste('Linear ',(AIC %~~% 18.1)))))
